arxiv-2203-01357.description: Abstract This Letter presents the detection of a source at the position of the Type Ib/c supernova (SN) 2013ge more than four years after the radioactive component is expected to have faded. This source could mark the first post-SN direct detection of a surviving companion to a stripped-envelope Type Ib/c explosion.

arxiv-2303-07466.description: Abstract Radio frequency (RF) fingerprinting is a tool which allows for authentication by utilizing distinct and random distortions in a received signal based on characteristics of the transmitter. We introduce a deep learning-based authentication method for a novel RF fingerprinting system called Physically Unclonable Wireless Systems (PUWS).

arxiv-2511-21818.title: The impact of magnetic fields during tidal disruption events 2015 The impact of magnetic fields during tidal disruption events – A
arxiv-2511-21818.creator: Simona Pacuraru, Clément Bonnerot, Martin E. Pessah
arxiv-2511-21818.description: Abstract During a tidal disruption event (TDE) the stream debris inherits the magnetic field of the star. As the stream stretches, the magnetic field evolves and can eventually become dynamically important. We study this effect by means of magnetohydrodynamic simulations and a semi-analytic model of the disruption of a main-sequence star by a supermassive black hole.

pmc-11652856.title: Quasi-Newton optimised Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for wind farm power prediction

Having accurate and effective wind energy forecasting that can be easily incorporated into smart networks is important. Appropriate planning and energy generation predictions are necessary for these infrastructures. The production of wind energy is linked to instability and unpredictability. Wind energy forecasting has traditionally been performed using statistical models, but with the advent of artificial intelligence (AI), research indicates that AI is more accurate than the statical technique.

pmc-12651159.title: Cardiovascular Disease in Pregnancy: When Two Hearts Beat as One
pmc-12651159.creator: Chiara Tognola, Filippo Brucato, Alessandro Maloberti, Marisa Varrenti, Alberto Preda, Patrizio Mazzone, Cristina Giannattasio, Fabrizio Guarracini
pmc-12651159.description: Background: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) in pregnancy is a major cause of maternal morbidity and mortality, accounting for nearly one-third of pregnancy-related deaths worldwide. Physiological adaptations—expanded plasma volume, increased cardiac output, and a prothrombotic state—represent a natural cardiovascular stress test that may precipitate decompensation or unmask subclinical disease.

uslaw-usc-t5-s315.title: 5 U.S.C. § 315 — Advisory Committee on Data for Evidence Building
uslaw-usc-t5-s315.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t5-s315.description: United States Code, Title 5 (Government Organization And Employees); Part I (The Agencies Generally); Chapter 3 (Powers); Subchapter II (Federal Evidence-Building Activities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment.— The Director, or the head of an agency designated by the Director, shall establish an Advisory Committee on Data for Evidence Building (in this section referred to as the “Advisory Committee”) to review.
